title: Examining risks of racial biases in NLP tools for child protective services

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing word overrepresentation in caseworker notes about Black versus White families using log-odds with a Dirichlet prior; comparing performance metrics (FPR, FNR, AUC, predicted risk scores) of risk assessment models for Black versus White children; and measuring recall disparities in Information Extraction systems, specifically Named Entity Recognition (NER) for Black versus White client names and coreference resolution on notes about Black-majority versus White-majority families.
